summary: The S&P 500 fell to 7,686.14 today, down 0.33%, as fresh US and Iran military strikes sent oil prices up 3.49% to $86.31 a barrel. Higher oil raises inflation fears, which in turn pushes bond yields up and stock prices down. Technology held up best, rising 0.44%, while most other sectors fell. Bitcoin gained 1.46% to $78,968 and gold edged up 0.43%, both acting as safe havens. A big week of jobs data begins Tuesday, starting with job openings and manufacturing reports.
